liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls it soulful and well sung; Reviewer singles out Black Peter as exceptional [4][5][12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Long transition from China Cat into a great I Know You Rider; Strong opener, with audible cowbells, Pigpen's organ and Jerry wailing [9][13]
- **Yellow Dog Story** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the Yellow Dog Story interesting; Reviewer says to skip it, since Bob was never good at telling jokes [7][9]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds this version plods along without settling into a groove; Reviewer calls the Dark Star magical [3][5]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Other One and St. Stephen are played well but not standout; band seems on autopilot overall [3]

## The recordings

- **gd70-01-23.sbd.fixed.connor.18153.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 127 min; rated 3.85/5 by 26 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds clean and crisp [3]
- **gd70-01-23.sbd.goodbear.88.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 98 min; rated 3.91/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound quality described as pretty good; Soundboard sound described as excellent [7][13]

## Around the show

- Reviewer guesses the set was short because of time limits, with Jefferson Airplane also on the bill [4]
- Attendee says Jefferson Airplane did not play that night; only about 75 people were in the audience [8]
- Attendee attributes the lackluster feel to the tiny crowd and the Dead not yet being popular [8]
- Having both a long Other One and Dark Star is rare for 1970; less special than the 2/13 show [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-01-23.sbd.fixed.connor.18153.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Teddy Goodbear and Charlie Connor; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Two postings circulated originally; uploader posted hours after another, with possibly slightly different track marks; This updated version splices the original Lovelight into the transfer [1]
- **gd70-01-23.sbd.goodbear.88.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by rockarchaeology101.blogspot.com: [January 23, 1970 Honolulu Civic Auditoriom, Honolulu, HI: Michael J. Brody (Strange Daze)](https://rockarchaeology101.blogspot.com/2020/07/january-23-1970-honolulu-civic.html) [16]
- Fan art by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - Dave's Picks Vol 19 - 1970-01-23 Honolulu Civic Auditorium, Honolulu, HI](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2016/07/grateful-dead-daves-picks-vol-19-1970.html) [17]
